definitions.explanation: Targeting something with great precision. Used for accurate targeting of a specific location, time, or topic.

examples.japanese: ピンポイントで{狙|ねら}う。
ピンポイントな{質問|しつもん}をされた。
examples.english: I was asked a very precise question.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}でピンポイントの{降水|こうすい}{確率|かくりつ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I checked the pinpoint precipitation probability on the weather forecast.

notes:
ピンポイント means targeting something with great precision. It functions both as a noun (ピンポイントで) and as a na-adjective (ピンポイントな).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピンポイントで{狙|ねら}う: to target precisely
- ピンポイント{予報|よほう}: pinpoint forecast
- ピンポイントな{指摘|してき}: precise observation/criticism
- ピンポイントに{届|とど}く: to reach exactly the right spot
